Hands-free voice for walking and driving

New content for paying users only; subscription activation problems (about 4)

App whitelist and unlocking characters through progress

586139454.differentiator: One goal, one number: 100 push-ups (or 200 squats, 20 pull-ups) in 6 weeks, with a level test and a program that grows with you.
